title: Nehemiah’s Brave Idea
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler with the big, brave heart that starts the hard thing, and tonight Nehemiah prays and then rises up to rebuild the broken walls: Beau says a quick prayer over a pile of toys too big to start and picks up one toy, then another.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because a prayer helped him feel brave. In Beau’s world today: Beau had a big pile of toys to clean up and it felt too big to start. His tummy felt worried. So Beau said a quick prayer — “Please help me” — took a deep breath, and picked up just one toy, then another. Soon the whole room was tidy! Just like Nehemiah prayed and then began the big work, Beau prayed and started, one little step at a time.
